industry.why: Neutral at industry level, carried, with the sector rows carrying the view (Integrated and multi-utilities B, Regulated networks C, Renewable generators D). Utilities at industry level were not readable this week (Jefferies' utilities dailies arrived without readable views) and no power-price reading reached the pack, so the condition for B (a second power-price reading with relative strength leaving D) is untested; relative strength D (27-Nov-26 against 25-Sep-26, not week on week; D prior). Counter-case: Oppenheimer's 2027 theme (Goldman, 22-Nov) is beneficiaries of lower bond yields, which is this industry. Moves to B on a second power-price reading with relative strength leaving D.

sector.key: E.3. Utilities - renewable generators and developers
sector.why: Underweight, carried: the debt-funded, longest-duration, most capex-dependent end of utilities, which this week's AI-linked credit widening and a contested Fed path punish; no source spoke to the energy transition. Relative strength F (27-Nov-26 against 25-Sep-26, not week on week; F prior). No Pool name. Counter-case: power is the political constraint on data centres. Back to C if the Fed path is marked down and relative strength leaves F.

geography.why: Double Underweight, carried, now on fresh evidence rather than the stale spread: France's forward-looking PMI fell to 46.2 to 46.8, near its record low, 'a deepening downturn' (S&P Global via Pivotus, 23-Nov; Goldman Economics, 24-Nov), Pivotus calls it 'a disaster', Macron is considering a constitutional 'golden rule' if markets stay unstable in January with Le Pen leading the polls (Pivotus, 23-Nov), and Stehn (Goldman, 22-Nov) expects France to stagnate until its elections. The premium in basis points was unread for a fourth week, so last week's staleness rule (to D if unread again) is overtaken by the political and activity evidence, said plainly. 15 Pool stocks are French-listed, most of them global businesses. Counter-case: a top letter on a country whose listed companies earn mostly abroad, and the mid-2027 election is far away. To D when the premium is read under 120 basis points for a month with the PMI off its low; to C under 100.
